source: OS London 1:5,280 skeleton survey 1848-51 (Metropolitan Commission of Sewers levelling), NLS XYZ tiles
datum: OD Liverpool (inferred: no datum note on the tiles; B.M.s agree with the 1890s OD Liverpool values to a few tenths of a foot; see mosaics-1848/lattice_index.json datum_notes)

datum_notes.status: NO datum statement found. The tiles show the map face only (neat lines, no margins or titles), so no note such as "above Ordnance Datum" or "Trinity High Water" could be read. Datum is INFERRED, not verified.
datum_notes.inference: Same datum as the 1890s sheets (OD Liverpool, first geodetic levelling) to within a few tenths of a foot; certainly not Trinity High Water, which would put every value about 12.5 ft lower (marsh values would be negative).
evidence: s18_131069_87140: B.M.16.6 at Abbey Mill Toll Bar (E 538876 N 183252) lies 5 m from the five-foot B.M. 16.46 (difference 0.14 ft).
s18_131069_87140: B.M.8.5 at the Mill Lane corner (E 538572 N 183321) lies 2 m from the five-foot spot 8.6.
Road levels on Abbey Mill Lane 7.6-9.3 and river-bank levels 15.9-16.6 match the five-foot values for the same settings (marsh roads 8-10, walls 16-19).
datum_notes.to_verify: Check a full sheet image on maps.nls.uk (title, margin notes) for the reference level of the skeleton levelling.

reading_notes.style: Levelling map: figures and B.M.s sit along roads, drain banks, sewers and river walls; the marsh interior is blank paper. Grey-brown fine engraving on buff paper.
reading_notes.digit_size_px: about 7-8 px tall at zoom 18 (a little larger than the five-foot 6 px); fine strokes, so read at 6-8x
reading_notes.spot_heights: Written to 1 dp with a heavy spaced middot (8 . 6, 15 . 9); the survey dot is a separate small dot beside the figure, usually on the road edge or bank line.
reading_notes.bench_marks: B.M. + pheon, to 1 dp (B.M.8.5, B.M.16.6, B.M.17.0), not 2 dp as on the five-foot.
reading_notes.blank_mosaics: Many mosaics (open marsh) are blank paper with at most a neat line; sweep at 2x and record no readings if none.
